title: Sebastian Sanchez | Software Engineer
description: Software Engineer building scalable backend systems, web applications, and mobile products with a focus on clean architecture and maintainable software.
ogDescription: Building scalable backend systems, web applications, and mobile products.

hero.heading: From idea
hero.description: I build my own products and software solutions for businesses. As the founder of VAUL Software, my work spans backend systems, web, and mobile apps.
hero.portraitAlt: Sebastian Sanchez on the Brooklyn Bridge

projectsPreview.heading: Selected Work
projectsPreview.intro: My own products, client projects, and developer tools. Each shows a different part of my work: defining the problem, building a solution, and putting it in the hands of the people who use it.

items.name: CourtRank
items.description: Bookings and management for padel clubs, connected to a player app. CourtRank brings club operations and the playing experience together in one product.
items.role: Product development, backend, and web and mobile integration.
items.outcome: Live website and iOS app published on the App Store.

items.name: PlayZone VIP
items.description: A website for a sports and entertainment venue. It organizes activities and helps visitors find information and contact the business.
items.role: Frontend development, responsive design, and deployment.
items.outcome: Published website presenting activities and making contact easier.

items.name: MVNEX
items.description: A C++ CLI that simplifies project creation and dependency workflows in Maven while keeping projects standard and compatible with its ecosystem.
items.role: Command design, C++ implementation, and documentation.
items.outcome: Tool in development, with a public repository and documentation.

company.heading: VAUL Software
company.description: I founded VAUL Software to build proprietary products and software solutions for businesses. CourtRank is one of its products; PlayZone VIP is one of its client projects.

expertise.heading: What I work with
expertise.intro: A balanced toolkit for designing product flows, implementing reliable services, shipping interfaces and keeping systems maintainable after the first release.

categories.name: Backend
categories.description: I enjoy building APIs, services and data flows that make products dependable. My backend work is usually shaped around clear boundaries, readable code and architecture that can evolve.

categories.name: Frontend
categories.description: I build interfaces that feel direct, responsive and useful. I care about the small details that make a product easier to understand, without losing sight of performance and accessibility.

categories.name: Engineering
categories.description: I like the engineering layer around the product: deployment, collaboration, maintainability, debugging and the habits that keep a codebase healthy over time.

aboutPreview.heading: Engineer, product builder, and founder.
aboutPreview.bio: I’m Sebastian, a software engineer and founder of VAUL Software. I build products like CourtRank and client solutions like PlayZone VIP. My work connects product decisions with backend architecture and the web and mobile interfaces people use.

closing.heading: Have a project or opportunity in mind?
closing.description: I'm always open to discussing new ideas, interesting projects or potential collaborations, especially when the work involves product engineering, backend systems, mobile apps or thoughtful web experiences.
